passages.heading: MD&A
passages.text: 41 Share Purchases and Redemptions We intend to continue to use a significant portion of cash generated from operations for share repurchases during fiscal 2026. The number of shares ultimately repurchased under our open-market share purchase program may vary depending on numerous factors, including, without limitation, share price and other market conditions, our ongoing capital allocation planning, the levels of cash and debt balances, other demands for cash, such as acquisition activity, general economic and/or business conditions, and board and management discretion. Additionally, as these factors may change over the course of the year, the amount of share repurchase activity during any particular period cannot be predicted and may fluctuate from time to time. Share repurchases may be made from time to time through open-market purchases, in respect of purchases and redemptions of Accenture Canada Holdings Inc. exchangeable shares, through the use of Rule 10b5-1 plans and/or by other means. The repurchase program may be accelerated, suspended, delayed or discontinued at any time, without notice. For additional information, see Note 14 (Shareholders’ Equity) to our Consolidated Financial Statements under Item 8, “Financial Statements and Supplementary Data.” Subsequent Events See Note 14 (Shareholders’ Equity) to our Consolidated Financial Statements under Item 8, “Financial Statements and Supplementary Data.” Obligations and Commitments As of August 31, 2025, we had commitments of $3 billion related to cloud hosting arrangements, software subscriptions, information technology services and other obligations in the ordinary course of business that we cannot cancel or where we would be required to pay a termination fee in the event of cancellation. Payments under these commitments are estimated to be made as follows: (in millions of U.S. dollars) Payments (1) Less than 1 year $ 1,154 1-3 years 1,275 3-5 years 513 More than 5 years 38 Total $ 2,980 (1) Amounts do not include recourse that we may have to recover termination fees or penalties from clients. For information about borrowing facilities and leases, see Note 10 (Borrowings and Indebtedness) and Note 8 (Leases) to our Consolidated Financial Statements under Item 8, “Financial Statements and Supplementary Data.” Off-Balance Sheet Arrangements In the normal course of business and in conjunction with some client engagements, we have entered into contractual arrangements through which we may be obligated to indemnify clients with respect to certain matters. To date, we have not been required to make any significant payment under any of these arrangements. For further discussion of these transactions, see Note 15 (Commitments and Contingencies) to our Consolidated Financial Statements under Item 8, “Financial Statements and Supplementary Data.” New Accounting Pronouncements See Note 1 (Summary of Significant Accounting Policies) to our Consolidated Financial Statements under Item 8, “Financial Statements and Supplementary Data.” Table of Contents ACCENTURE 2025 FORM 10-K Item 7A. These claims could harm our reputation, cause us to incur substantial costs or prevent us from offering some solutions or services in the future. Any related proceedings could require us to expend significant resources over an extended period of time. In most of our contracts, we agree to indemnify our clients for expenses and liabilities resulting from claimed infringements of the intellectual property rights of third parties. In some instances, the amount of these indemnities could be greater than the revenues we receive from the client. Any claims or litigation in this area could be time-consuming and costly, damage our reputation and/or require us to incur additional costs to obtain the right to continue to offer a service or solution to our clients. If we cannot secure this right at all or on reasonable terms, or we are unable to implement in a cost-effective manner alternative technology, our results of operations could be materially adversely affected. The risk of infringement claims against us may increase as we expand our industry AI, software and hardware solutions and continue to develop and deploy our AI, software and hardware solutions to multiple clients. Any infringement action brought against us or our clients could be costly to defend or lead to an expensive settlement or judgment against us. Further, we rely on third-party software, hardware, data and other intellectual property in providing some of our solutions and services. If we lose our ability to continue using any such software, hardware, data or intellectual property for any reason, including because it is found to infringe the rights of others, we will need to obtain substitutes or seek alternative means of obtaining the technology necessary to continue to provide such solutions and services. Our inability to replace such software, hardware, data or intellectual property effectively or in a timely and cost-effective manner could materially adversely affect our results of operations. We are incorporated in Ireland and Irish law differs from the laws in effect in the United States and might afford less protection to our shareholders. We may also be subject to criticism and negative publicity related to our incorporation in Ireland. Irish law differs from the laws in effect in the United States and our shareholders could have more difficulty protecting their interests than would shareholders of a corporation incorporated in a jurisdiction of the United States. credit_strengths.text: Accenture generates substantial operating cash flow that dwarfs reported debt, and free cash flow covers borrowings multiple times over, so internal liquidity rather than refinancing underpins debt service. The business converts revenue into cash consistently, with operating cash flow exceeding net income and comfortably funding capital expenditure, working capital and routine obligations.

The balance sheet carries a net cash position because cash and equivalents exceed interest-bearing debt, and gross leverage sits far below the sector median. Interest coverage is exceptionally high relative to Industrials peers, reflecting both modest borrowings and strong operating profitability, which provides ample headroom against a downturn in consulting demand.

key_risks.text: The risk-factor passage highlights intellectual property infringement claims, including client indemnities that can exceed engagement revenue, and notes rising exposure as AI and software solutions expand. Such claims could be costly to defend, damage reputation, or require substitute technology, potentially disrupting service delivery and pressuring operating results.

Debt maturities are concentrated beyond the near term, with the largest repayments falling in later years, so refinancing risk is deferred rather than absent. Share repurchases absorb a significant portion of operating cash flow, and management intends to continue that program, which could reduce the liquidity buffer available if borrowing conditions tighten.

debt_servicing_capacity.text: Interest coverage is far above the sector median, and free cash flow to debt is similarly strong, indicating that operating income alone covers interest many times over. With cash exceeding debt, the company could retire borrowings from balance-sheet resources, so debt service depends more on business continuity than on access to refinancing.

Operating cash flow and free cash flow are large relative to the debt stack, and the current ratio exceeds the sector median, supporting near-term liquidity. Capital expenditure is modest compared with cash generation, leaving substantial discretionary cash after debt service, although share buybacks and cloud commitments consume part of that surplus.

overall_credit_view.text: Accenture presents a minimal indicative financial risk profile, with net cash, leverage well below the sector median and coverage far above it. Revenue and operating income have grown steadily, and the Altman Z double prime zone is safe, so the credit trajectory appears stable absent a severe demand shock or large debt-funded acquisition.

The main credit considerations are event risk from intellectual property litigation and the pace of shareholder distributions, which absorb most free cash flow. Maturities are deferred, and the company retains ample capacity to fund operations, buybacks and commitments, so I view the credit as strong, with monitoring focused on cash deployment and contingent liabilities.

credit_strengths.text: Accenture 產生龐大營運現金流，遠超帳面債務，而自由現金流覆蓋借款數倍，因此支撐債務償付的是內部流動性而非再融資。該業務持續將收入轉化為現金，營運現金流超過淨收入，並充裕地為資本開支、營運資金及日常義務提供資金。
資產負債表呈淨現金狀況，因現金及等價物超過計息債務，而總槓桿遠低於行業中位數。利息覆蓋率相對於工業同業異常高，反映借款規模適度及營運盈利能力強勁，為諮詢需求下滑提供充足緩衝。

key_risks.text: 風險因素章節強調知識產權侵權索賠，包括可能超過項目收入的客戶賠償，並指出隨著人工智能及軟件解決方案擴展，相關風險敞口上升。此類索賠可能導致高昂抗辯成本、損害聲譽或需要替代技術，可能干擾服務交付並對營運業績構成壓力。
債務到期集中於較長遠期間，最大還款額落在較後年份，因此再融資風險是延後而非不存在。股份回購吸收營運現金流的顯著部分，而管理層打算繼續該計劃，若借款條件收緊，可能減少可用的流動性緩衝。

debt_servicing_capacity.text: 利息覆蓋率遠高於行業中位數，而自由現金流對債務比率同樣強勁，表明僅營運收入已可覆蓋利息多倍。由於現金超過債務，公司可從資產負債表資源償還借款，因此債務償付更依賴業務持續性而非再融資渠道。
營運現金流及自由現金流相對於債務規模龐大，而流動比率超過行業中位數，支持短期流動性。資本開支相對於現金產生而言適度，在償付債務後留下大量可自由支配現金，儘管股份回購及雲端承諾消耗部分盈餘。

overall_credit_view.text: Accenture 呈現極低的指示性財務風險狀況，淨現金、槓桿遠低於行業中位數且覆蓋率遠高於該水平。收入及營運收入穩步增長，而 Altman Z 雙質數區間安全，因此若無嚴重需求衝擊或大規模債務融資收購，信用軌跡似乎穩定。
主要信用考量為知識產權訴訟的事件風險及股東分派速度，後者吸收大部分自由現金流。債務到期延後，而公司保留充足能力為營運、回購及承諾提供資金，因此我認為信用強勁，監測重點在於現金部署及或然負債。
